scope: Read-only audit of installed IndexTTS 2.5 implementation, official usage, example cases and published demo setup; no new inference or parameter changes in this audit.

current_run.text: I need you to stay right here.
current_run.listener_result: User reports less anger than the source example, with calmness remaining.

established: Installed path uses separate identity and emotion audio, matching the documented API pattern.
Current README documents reference strength from zero to one; our latest take is already at one.

The installed model computes base_emotion + alpha * (guide_emotion - base_emotion); at alpha one this part equals the guide embedding, not an exact acoustic performance copy. Other speaker-conditioning paths remain.
Official English anger examples show an emotional audio-prompt condition; the separate identity/emotion section is a distinct experiment.
Emotion vector control is an alternative mode. The installed implementation clears the external emotion audio when a vector is used; they must not be represented as simultaneously applied.
An older IndexTTS 2 demo includes a 1.4 emotion-weight condition, while current IndexTTS 2.5 usage documents zero to one. Treat any extrapolation as an unqualified experiment, not a production fix.
Official demonstrations contain multi-sentence examples. Our single-sentence gate is an adopted local experimental standard, not a documented model requirement.
